title: Democrats won Congress, but their Trump obsession could give it right back
summary: Democrats won Congress, but Republicans must counter investigations with a practical agenda on affordability, energy and national security.

title: Stephen A Smith debriefs interview with President Trump, warns Democrats face steep challenge

title: Healthy runner suffers sudden stroke at 27 as doctors discover possible cause
summary: Patrick Mascoli was running 40 miles a week when a stroke struck at 27. Doctors found a patent foramen ovale that likely sent a clot to his brain.
